projectDescription: An encrypted proxy for browser JavaScript that enables CORS-bypassing HTTPS/WebSocket requests by running TLS inside WebAssembly over the Wisp multiplexing protocol.
keyFeatures: Runs full TLS/SSL inside WebAssembly for true end-to-end encryption in browsers
Bypasses CORS restrictions without sacrificing security
Implements the Wisp v1/v2 multiplexing protocol over WebSockets
Supports HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, WebSocket proxying, raw TCP, TLS, and UDP streams
Performant Rust-based Wisp server (epoxy-server) with host/port filtering and authentication
Wisp v2 protocol extensions: UDP, MOTD, password auth, certificate auth
Multiple npm bundle variants: full (HTTP/2 + compression) and minimal (HTTP/1 only)
Custom Wisp transport support via WebSocketStream or any ReadableStream/WritableStream pair
Rust wisp-mux library for building Wisp clients and servers
TWisp extension for PTY terminal forwarding through Wisp streams
